answer: Require every agent to carry a sable-stamped, hash-chained history of real work done for independent counterparties: each new task's proof links to the previous one, so a farm cannot clone a history in parallel. Trust flows like a zephyr across an island chain — it only reaches identities vouched for by already-trusted agents outside the applicant's own cluster. One extra fake identity costs a full fresh chain of independently attested jobs, weeks of real service, not a fee paid once.
